fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Romania follows Schengen area rules and requires a passport with an expiry date at least 3 months after you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Rumanía sigue las normas Schengen y exige un pasaporte que caduque al menos 3 meses después de la fecha prevista de salida del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: You may also need to show a return or onward ticket and prove you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: Es posible que también debas mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación y demostrar que tienes dinero suficiente para tu estancia.
entry.quote:
You may also need to:

- show a return or onward ticket

- prove that you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: Carry your passport when travelling to other Schengen countries, as border guards check it at land or river borders with Bulgaria or Hungary.
entry.es: Lleva el pasaporte al viajar a otros países Schengen, ya que los guardias fronterizos lo revisan en las fronteras terrestres o fluviales con Bulgaria o Hungría.
entry.quote: Border guards will check it if you cross land or river borders into Bulgaria or Hungary

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo under the EU Entry/Exit System, at no cost.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas, puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y foto en el Sistema de Entrada/Salida de la UE, sin coste.
entry.quote: you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo. There is no cost for EES registration.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries, with some exceptions such as baby milk and baby food.
entry.es: No se puede introducir carne, leche ni productos que los contengan en países de la UE, con excepciones como la leche en polvo y la comida para bebés.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries. There are some exceptions such as powdered baby milk, baby food

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more when bringing them into Romania.
entry.es: Debes declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 euros o más al entrar en Rumanía.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

safety.en: Petty theft is a concern in large towns, especially Bucharest, with thieves using distraction techniques and sometimes organised group attacks.
safety.es: El hurto es una preocupación en las ciudades grandes, sobre todo Bucarest, con ladrones que usan técnicas de distracción y a veces ataques organizados en grupo.
safety.quote: Be alert to petty theft in large towns, especially Bucharest. Thieves use distraction techniques and can carry out organised attacks in groups.

safety.en: Belongings need particular care near money exchanges and hotels, on public transport to the airport, in main railway stations and inside airport terminals.
safety.es: Conviene extremar el cuidado con las pertenencias cerca de casas de cambio y hoteles, en el transporte público al aeropuerto, en las estaciones de tren principales y en las terminales.
safety.quote:
near money exchanges and hotels

- on public transport, especially to the airport

- in main railway stations

- inside airport terminals

safety.en: There is a risk of drink spiking in bars and clubs.
safety.es: Existe riesgo de que adulteren las bebidas en bares y discotecas.
safety.quote: There is a risk of drink spiking in bars and clubs.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties, and increasing numbers of people have been arrested for drug offences at music festivals.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas, y cada vez más personas han sido detenidas por delitos de drogas en festivales de música.
safety.quote: Increasing numbers of people, including foreign visitors, have been arrested and received lengthy sentences for drug offences at music festivals in Romania.

safety.en: Taxi drivers sometimes overcharge foreign visitors, while taxi apps such as Uber and Bolt are generally reliable.
safety.es: Los taxistas a veces cobran de más a los visitantes extranjeros, mientras que apps como Uber y Bolt suelen ser fiables.
safety.quote: Taxi drivers sometimes overcharge foreign visitors. Taxi apps such as Uber and Bolt are generally reliable.

safety.en: Romania is seismically active and tremors happen regularly, though the last major earthquake was in 1977.
safety.es: Rumanía es una zona sísmicamente activa y los temblores son habituales, aunque el último gran terremoto fue en 1977.
safety.quote: Romania is in a seismically active area and tremors happen regularly. The last major earthquake was in 1977.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Romania.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Rumanía.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Romania.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Romania, a UK traveller needs a GHIC or EHIC, which is not an alternative to travel insurance.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en Rumanía hace falta una GHIC o EHIC, que no sustituye al seguro de viaje.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Romania, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Tap water is generally potable, but most people choose to drink bottled water instead.
health.es: El agua del grifo es en general potable, pero la mayoría de la gente prefiere beber agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water is generally potable, but most people choose to drink bottled water instead.

health.en: Hospital conditions vary from very clean and modern to drab and outdated, although medical staff are usually experienced.
health.es: Las condiciones de los hospitales varían desde muy limpias y modernas hasta anticuadas, aunque el personal médico suele tener experiencia.
health.quote: Conditions in Romanian hospitals may vary from the very clean and sparkling, with all the latest technological utilities, to the downright drab, dark and cold.

health.en: Dental work in Romania, especially in private clinics, is described as excellent quality.
health.es: Los tratamientos dentales en Rumanía, sobre todo en clínicas privadas, se describen como de excelente calidad.
health.quote: Dental procedures in Romania, especially those in private clinics, are of an excellent quality.

help.en: The emergency number in Romania is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Rumanía es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: FCDO can be called in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, 24 horas, si le ha pasado algo a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.

getting_in.en: Henri Coandă (Otopeni) Airport in Bucharest is described as the largest and busiest airport in Romania.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Henri Coandă (Otopeni) de Bucarest se describe como el más grande y concurrido de Rumanía.
getting_in.quote: Henri Coandă (Otopeni) Airport (OTP IATA), Bucharest – The largest and busiest airport.

getting_in.en: Cluj International Airport is the largest airport in Transylvania and a hub of Wizz Air.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Cluj es el mayor de Transilvania y uno de los centros de Wizz Air.
getting_in.quote: Cluj International Airport (CLJ IATA), Cluj-Napoca – The largest airport in Transylvania

getting_in.en: Romania has borders with Ukraine, Bulgaria, Serbia, Moldova and Hungary.
getting_in.es: Rumanía tiene frontera con Ucrania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Moldavia y Hungría.
getting_in.quote: Romania has borders with the following countries: Ukraine, Bulgaria, Serbia, Moldova, and Hungary.

getting_in.en: Daily international trains run to cities including Munich, Venice, Vienna, Budapest, Zagreb, Belgrade, Sofia and Istanbul, and Romania is part of the Interrail pass offer.
getting_in.es: Hay trenes internacionales diarios a ciudades como Múnich, Venecia, Viena, Budapest, Zagreb, Belgrado, Sofía y Estambul, y Rumanía forma parte de la oferta Interrail.
getting_in.quote: There are daily international trains to Munich, Venice, Vienna, Budapest, Zagreb, Belgrade, Sofia, Istanbul, Chișinău, Kyiv, and Moscow.

getting_in.en: Ferries cross the Danube from Bulgaria, from Bechet to Oryahovo daily and from Zimnicea to Svishtov only at weekends.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris que cruzan el Danubio desde Bulgaria, de Bechet a Oryahovo a diario y de Zimnicea a Svishtov solo los fines de semana.
getting_in.quote: There are ferries across the Danube from Bulgaria in several ports: from Bechet to Oryahovo (daily) and from Zimnicea to Svishtov (only on weekends).

getting_in.en: There is no direct Ukraine-Romania border crossing in the south-eastern corner of Moldavia, so drivers must go via Giurgiulesti in Moldova.
getting_in.es: No hay paso fronterizo directo entre Ucrania y Rumanía en el sureste de Moldavia, por lo que hay que pasar por Giurgiulesti, en Moldavia.
getting_in.quote: There is not a direct border crossing between Ukraine and Romania in the south-eastern corner of Romanian Moldavia (Reni/Galati), you must go via Giurgiulesti, which is in Moldova

getting_around.en: Trains remain the best option for long-distance travel, though the rail network is in poor condition with low speeds and limited frequency on many routes.
getting_around.es: Los trenes siguen siendo la mejor opción para largas distancias, aunque la red está en mal estado, con baja velocidad y poca frecuencia en muchas rutas.
getting_around.quote: Nonetheless trains remain the best option for long distance travel.

getting_around.en: Regio trains are very slow, stop at almost every station and are best avoided, while InterRegio and Intercity offer reasonable conditions.
getting_around.es: Los trenes Regio son muy lentos, paran en casi todas las estaciones y es mejor evitarlos, mientras que InterRegio e Intercity ofrecen condiciones razonables.
getting_around.quote: The last two types provide reasonable conditions but Regio trains are best avoided.

getting_around.en: All train types except Regio and RegioExpress require a seat reservation.
getting_around.es: Todos los tipos de tren excepto Regio y RegioExpress exigen reserva de asiento.
getting_around.quote: All trains types except Regio and RegioExpress require seat reservation

getting_around.en: Boarding a CFR train without a ticket from a station with ticket sellers can lead to a fine and a more expensive ticket from the train staff.
getting_around.es: Subir a un tren de CFR sin billete desde una estación con taquilla puede suponer una multa y un billete más caro comprado al personal del tren.
getting_around.quote: People that board CFR trains without a ticket from stations where there are ticket sellers can be fined and have to buy more expensive tickets directly from the train staff.

getting_around.en: Driving in Romania requires a road tax sticker, the Rovinieta, and driving without one incurs a severe fine.
getting_around.es: Para conducir en Rumanía hace falta la viñeta de peaje, la Rovinieta, y circular sin ella conlleva una multa severa.
getting_around.quote: you must purchase a road tax sticker (the "Rovinieta") either from the border or from the nearest gas station. Driving without one will incur a severe fine.

getting_around.en: Winter tyres are compulsory by law between November and early March, and the police have a zero tolerance policy on drunk driving.
getting_around.es: Los neumáticos de invierno son obligatorios por ley entre noviembre y principios de marzo, y la policía tiene tolerancia cero con la conducción bajo los efectos del alcohol.
getting_around.quote: Between November and early March, the use of winter tyres is compulsory by law in Romania

money.en: The national currency is the leu (plural lei), divided into 100 bani.
money.es: La moneda nacional es el leu (plural lei), dividido en 100 bani.
money.quote: The national currency of Romania is the leu (plural lei), which means lion in Romanian. The leu is divided into 100 bani

money.en: Using your ATM card at a local bank ATM is described as the safest and easiest way to obtain Romanian cash.
money.es: Usar la tarjeta en un cajero de un banco local se describe como la forma más segura y sencilla de obtener efectivo rumano.
money.quote: the safest and easiest way to obtain Romanian cash is to use your ATM card at any local bank ATM.

money.en: Exchanging money in the street is illegal and black market transactions should be avoided, as most black marketers are con men.
money.es: Cambiar dinero en la calle es ilegal y conviene evitar el mercado negro, ya que la mayoría de quienes lo ofrecen son estafadores.
money.quote: Absolutely avoid black market transactions with strangers

money.en: Romanian transactions generally take place in cash, and paying in euros or US dollars where prices are in lei may get a worse rate or be refused.
money.es: Las transacciones en Rumanía suelen hacerse en efectivo, y pagar en euros o dólares donde los precios están en lei puede dar un peor cambio o ser rechazado.
money.quote: Romanian transactions generally take place in cash.

money.en: The Bucharest subway and RATB public transport are cash-only, and it is advisable to always carry about 50 lei in cash.
money.es: El metro de Bucarest y el transporte público RATB solo admiten efectivo, y se aconseja llevar siempre unos 50 lei en efectivo.
money.quote: It is advisable to always have a small sum of money in cash (about 50 lei or even more), even in large cities.

money.en: A tip is usually 5-10% of the bill and is expected in restaurants, coffee shops, taxis and hair dressers.
money.es: La propina suele ser del 5-10% de la cuenta y se espera en restaurantes, cafeterías, taxis y peluquerías.
money.quote: A tip is usually 5-10% of the bill and is expected in restaurants, coffee shops, taxi, hair dressers.

etiquette.en: Romanians insist when offering something, and a refusal is considered polite for you and insistence polite for them.
etiquette.es: Los rumanos insisten al ofrecer algo, y se considera cortés que rechaces y cortés que ellos insistan.
etiquette.quote: they just consider it polite for you to refuse and polite for them to insist.

etiquette.en: It is expected to shake hands with everybody when entering a room or gathering of people.
etiquette.es: Se espera dar la mano a todo el mundo al entrar en una habitación o reunión.
etiquette.quote: It is always expected to shake hands with everybody when entering a room or gathering of people.

etiquette.en: Guests are expected to take off their shoes when entering someone's house.
etiquette.es: Se espera que los invitados se quiten los zapatos al entrar en casa de alguien.
etiquette.quote: When entering someone's house, the guest is expected to take off shoes.

etiquette.en: It is impolite to get drunk in public.
etiquette.es: Es de mala educación emborracharse en público.
etiquette.quote: It is impolite to get drunk in public.

etiquette.en: Avoid discussing ethnic animosities between Romanians and ethnic Hungarians.
etiquette.es: Evita hablar de las animosidades étnicas entre rumanos y húngaros étnicos.
etiquette.quote: Avoid discussing the ethnic animosities between the Romanians and ethnic Hungarians.

etiquette.en: Being overly enthusiastic about Russia could provoke a hostile response because anti-Russian sentiment is high.
etiquette.es: Mostrar demasiado entusiasmo por Rusia podría provocar una reacción hostil, pues el sentimiento antirruso es alto.
etiquette.quote: Anti-Russian sentiment is high due to the history of Soviet domination.

connectivity.en: There are four GSM/3G mobile networks, and Orange and Vodafone have almost full national coverage.
connectivity.es: Hay cuatro redes móviles GSM/3G, y Orange y Vodafone tienen cobertura nacional casi total.
connectivity.quote: Orange and Vodafone have almost full national coverage (98-99% of the surface of the country)

connectivity.en: Pre-paid cards or recharge codes can be bought in almost every shop, rural or urban.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas prepago o los códigos de recarga se pueden comprar en casi todas las tiendas, rurales o urbanas.
connectivity.quote: Pre-paid cards or recharge codes can be bought in almost every shop, either rural or urban.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi is widely available in university areas, airports, public squares, parks, cafes, hotels and restaurants.
connectivity.es: El wifi está muy extendido en zonas universitarias, aeropuertos, plazas, parques, cafeterías, hoteles y restaurantes.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi widely available in University areas, airports, public squares, parks, cafes, hotels and restaurants.

connectivity.en: Most McDonald's restaurants in Romania and most 3-star or higher hotels have Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de los McDonald's de Rumanía y de los hoteles de 3 estrellas o más tienen wifi.
connectivity.quote: Most (if not all) McDonald's restaurants in Romania have Wi-Fi access and so do most 3-star (and higher) hotels.

phrases.quote: "Bună ziua" (Boo-nuh Zee-wah) which means "Good day" or "Good afternoon."
